name: scheduler-get
description: Read one scheduled job in full by ID: its whole taskPayload (task text in .task), schedule, linked task, and last run's summary, context and outcome. Use it to quote a routine's instructions, review a job or a bad run, and before a scheduler-update that passes task_payload. Fields in truncatedFields were cut to fit; the task text never is.

outputs.job: object (scheduler-list summary plus taskPayload, lastRunSummary, lastRunContext, progress)
